messages:
sam-ops: Heads-up: small rolling maintenance tonight 02:30-03:00 UTC on apac-edge racks to apply NIC microcode and reboot 1 node per rack. Expect brief p95 blips and ~6% capacity dip. Plan: cordon -> drain (grace 60s) -> reboot -> kvseed -> smoke test -> uncordon.

kai-infra: Ack. Which racks? any reserved backfill?

sam-ops: racks apac-edge-rack-04..06, nodes ending -02. We'll spin 2 temporary burst nodes in apac-burst for 45m. Cost estimate ~+$180.

nina-sre: tagging runbook and thresholds: p95>500ms or error-rate x1.4 -> abort and reroute. I'll monitor and join during window.

anya-mlops: Please set a 5 minute 3% canary after kvseed so I can run a short quality check.

sam-ops: Will do. Canary model gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03. Commands we'll run:
```
infractl cordon --node apac-edge-rack-04-02
infractl drain --node apac-edge-rack-04-02 --grace 60
infractl reboot --node apac-edge-rack-04-02 --warm
infractl kvseed --node apac-edge-rack-04-02 --primer apac-mini
infractl route-set canary gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03 --pct 3
```

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket INC-2026-2005 created; preflight reminder 02:10 UTC.

kai-infra: LGTM. I'll stand by to spawn extra burst if p95 stays high.

sam-ops: Great, will post customer note in #support 30m before.
